params.prompt:
TONAL AND MATERIAL CORRECTION ONLY. Edit the supplied approved composition into ONE full-frame 16:9 image. Preserve EXACT framing, geometry, typography, all wording, numeric values, positions and sizes of every HUD element. Do not redesign or add detail.
The previous result looks excessively HDR-processed: harsh local contrast, razor-sharp surface detail, sparkling wet highlights and crushed black shadows. Correct these qualities visibly. Use subdued photographic microcontrast, gentler transitions through the midtones, smooth restrained highlight roll-off, soft natural reflected light, imperfect matte material response. Reduce clarity/texture sharpening especially concrete, metal edges and wet patches. Do not replace this with global darkness, gray fog, a milky lifted-black wash, blurry lettering or defocus. Keep spatial depth and danger readable.
For any photographic background: MOST concrete is dull gray-green rough matte with varied dry/damp patches; reflections remain only in actual small puddles and water, broad and subdued rather than tiny white glitter. Rust is dark and diffuse, not polished metal. Suppress specular halos and hot white outlines. Reveal modest shadow detail in solid surfaces while voids remain dark. No cinematic HDR crunch, plastic varnish, chrome, exaggerated wetness, orange teal grading or contrast boost.
HUD: keep crisp legible coding monospace text and precise thin geometric strokes, but reduce white-hot brightness and phosphor bloom. Muted luminous green on observation/mission/transfer; restrained red on completion. Graphics stay clean, not blurred. Preserve the hierarchy between dim secondary lines and primary information. No new labels, data, glyphs or layout.

This is the MISSION ON BLACK frame. Keep the background black, no hall. Reduce the harsh white title and intense line glow to readable pale green with understated bloom; preserve exact mission objectives and contour design. Do not make black gray. No photographic environment is to be added.
